rows.en: What!? I will make this beautiful planet mine with my own hands, without fail!
Mefilas! I won't let you! Shuwatch!

Hahaha…

It would be a problem for me if you turned into Ultraman! So sleep there nice and peacefully! Hahaha…
Cap, we succeeded in rescuing Dr. Mori! We've arrived on Earth, but…
You've arrived, and what happened?
A strange signal, Cap!
A strange signal?
On our way back to Earth we picked up a strange signal… We searched for its source and found a mysterious spaceship.
A mysterious spaceship?
We'll land and search inside the ship.
Wait, don't overdo it! Are you carrying weapons?

Heh heh heh… I secretly built this, just in case something like this happened!

It's no match for Dr. Iwamoto's inventions, but… the Mars 133! It should pack quite a punch.

The Mars 133…!?

All right, understood! But be very careful!

…!?

Officer Fuji!
Arashi, Ide!?
Ah… Daisaku, and Officer Anne… and Annie too?
Is everyone all right?
Arashi, Ide! Quick, the switch on the instrument panel!
Hm? This one?
We're saved…
Thank you…
Ide, Arashi!
Now, hurry and get out! The fire's reached the engine room!
Arashi, what about Hayata? Where's Hayata?
He doesn't seem to be here… We're out of time! Let's go!
Fly, fly! Giant Robo!
Giant Robo: "Mah!"
Let's go, Giant Robo!

Hahaha! Stop that…

Let us stop fighting… I dislike fighting.
Who on earth are you…? Show yourself!

There's no need… I can see you.

Alien Baltan, Alien Zarab… all of them can attack the Earth on my orders!

You are little ants who think your tiny garden is the whole world. You mustn't overestimate your own strength…

Unlike them, I dislike resorting to violence! I came to challenge the human heart.
The heart?
That's right… Very soon now, Daisaku will accept my request.

Daisaku… Think very carefully, now.

You could even become the ruler of a great planet like the Earth! Now, give me your answer, quickly!
No! I'll say it as many times as it takes! The Earth belongs to all humankind!
So you've finally shown your true form, Alien Zarab!
So it was Alien Baltan after all!?
"Alien Mefilas… Go back to your own planet, now!"
"You spy…"
"Come on, then!"

"Let's not, Ultraman…

There's no point in aliens fighting each other. What I wanted was the heart of the Earth! But I lost… I lost even to a child.

Still, I haven't given up. Someday there is sure to be a human who will sell the Earth to me.

That day will come! Hahaha…"
What's wrong, [HERO4]?
No… it's nothing.

Why didn't Ultraman fight…?

That's what you want to know, isn't it, [HERO4]?

…!?

How did you know?
It's written all over your face.
On my face…?

What, that's what you were thinking about?

The answer's simple… I think the two aliens were talking. With something like telepathy that we can't hear…
I understand that, but…
Then what is it?

Everyone is fighting for the Earth…

Fighting day after day after day…

I heard the voices of Ultraman and Alien Mefilas… No, I felt as if I heard them.

They were like a sad cry… of being aliens, of never being able to become Earthlings…

Isn't it because they can have a strong sense of identity with this beautiful Earth that they can fight for it?

Isn't it the pride of being an Earthling that gives them the strength of spirit to overcome any hardship?

If that's so…

If that's so… then me, who isn't an Earthling… no, who isn't even human…

What meaning does my existence have…? That's what I ended up feeling.
[HERO4]…

[HERO4]…

We're not fighting for our own identity or ideology!

If we were… it'd just turn into another war.

We fight for the people who need us! Everyone has someone who needs them…

Even you, [HERO4]!
Someone who needs me?

They might be closer than you think…

Oyassan, I'm heading out on patrol! See you…

What's with him? He's never gone on patrol in his life…

Ah… [HERO4]. At a time like this, any human being would just go chasing after him, you know?
Huh…? Ah, yes!
Hmm… Those two are pretty good together, aren't they? Eh?
Eh, ah… Yes, I guess so?
But… I think I understand how [HERO4] feels…
Annie…
Oh, stop it… You're reading too much into it, Shaider!

By the way, Mr. Tachibana…

What kind of person is this doctor who's going to join the TDF's Science Group?

Oh, Dr. Iwamoto?

Hmm… let's see. He's the opposite of Dr. Mori, who was just rescued from the "Otori"…
…Meaning?

Mm…

Dr. Mori, who boarded a rocket with a 99% success rate himself and flew off into space…

and Dr. Iwamoto, who waits patiently until he's built a 100% perfect rocket, even if people say he lost the race…

As a scientist, which do you think is the braver, more correct choice? That's the kind of man Dr. Iwamoto is…
The beautiful blue Earth… We must protect this home of mankind from every invasion.
All the more, we must never become the kind of people who would sell out the Earth! The next thing Alien Mefilas challenges may be your heart…
Defeat the Vicious Alien Zarab and rescue Anne Yuri and Annie!
Defeat Space Ninja Alien Baltan and the Vicious Alien Zarab, and rescue Anne Yuri and Annie!
Defeat Space Ninja Alien Baltan, the Vicious Alien Zarab and the Gigants, and rescue Anne Yuri and Annie!
Defeat Space Ninja Alien Baltan, the Vicious Alien Zarab, the Gigants, Giant Anne Yuri and Giant Annie!
Defeat Space Ninja Alien Baltan, the Vicious Alien Zarab, the Gigants, Giant Anne Yuri, Giant Annie and the Malicious Alien Mefilas!
Anne Yuri or Annie is defeated, or all allies are destroyed

Shadow Knight… We deliberately designed Mari as a kind-hearted android so she would win Zero-One's sympathy!

All of it… was so that woman would blow herself up, taking Zero-One with her!

I am terribly sorry…

Mari's kindness proved stronger than we expected. At the very last step, she took pity on Zero-One and came running back!
Zadam…
Yes, Big Shadow, sir…

U11417/U11418: the giant Anne/Annie are revealed as Zarab and Baltan in disguise.
U11419-U11422: 『』 telepathic dialogue between Ultraman and Mefilas rendered in "double quotes" (U11429 confirms telepathy).
U11432: 諸り read as 誇り "pride"; 存任 read as 存在 "existence". [HERO4] says she is not human.
U11437: 人間なら rendered "any human being would…" - Tobei gently treating [HERO4] as human after U11432.

U11451-U11456: heavily garbled; reconstructed from U11452: 辿黙苦宙味 = 凶悪宇宙人 "Vicious Alien", 苦宙哈者 = 宇宙忍者, 百味 = 星人, 膤姉 = 友里, 官現 = 巨大 (glossary Giant Anne Yuri / Giant Annie), 黙沈苦宙味 = 悪質宇宙人 "Malicious Alien", 住て = 全て, 応え = 救え, 駄班 = 場合, 冗復が住改 = 味方が全滅. Please verify.
